title: AvatarGroup
summary: Overlapping avatars with a +N tile for the overflow.

writes.why: Every avatar past max gets hidden, and loses it again when max grows or an avatar is removed before it. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: role=group with a label; the +N tile is text, so the count of hidden people is available without seeing them.

examples.title: Overflow
examples.html:
<pk-avatar-group max="2" label="Team">
  <pk-avatar name="Ada L"></pk-avatar>
  <pk-avatar name="Sam L"></pk-avatar>
  <pk-avatar name="Ana R"></pk-avatar>
</pk-avatar-group>
